crossRefs.note: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”

parallels.note: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”
Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

translations.web: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”
translations.bsb: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”
translations.kjv: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
translations.asv: In the resurrection whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
